published_source: Printed Table 2, Panel A, column (4) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01838.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output in authors_code_* to the printed decimals. Earlier: Article tables not available in the project (no data/text file). authors_code_* = output of the authors' Replicate.R line 593 on the shipped final data (README: the package reproduces all tables). Table/column labels follow the section comments in Replicate.R (unverified against the article).
replication_status: exact (fixest with the authors' FE reproduces Replicate.R line 593: 0.152224 vs felm 0.152224, SE 0.069428 vs 0.069428, N 149190; abstract: 16% increase in R&D; exp(0.1522)-1 = 16.4%)
notes: Kang (2025), 'Price-Fixing Cartels and Firm Innovation', Management Science 71(11). Package: Replicate.R + final cleaned/merged .rds files (real processed data; raw DOJ/VitalLaw, PatentsView and licensed Compustat not shipped). FE: unit + 4-digit-NAICS (patents) or Compustat industry group (R&D) x year (authors: felm(... | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl)); here xt_vars = naics4 (= cl) so the time FE is year + year x cl; SE clustered by cl. No controls, no weights. Outcomes are IHS-transformed counts/amounts, precomputed as ihs_* (log(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)), as in Replicate.R). Formation design, Compustat R&D (data_reg_rnd.rds; 14,691 gvkeys, 72 industry groups, fyear 1950-2020). Sample exactly as Replicate.R line 593: treated gvkeys at TimeFromY in {-5..-2, 0..3} (0 = formation fiscal year; relative year -1 dropped by the authors), all controls, minus the authors' singleton list (exl, computed on TimeFromY in {-4..-2, 0..2}) -> flag s_T2_c4. Because the authors drop relative year -1, gvar g_form_m1 = formation year - 1 (onset dated at the start of the dropped year, as for an anticipation bin, PROTOCOL 5b); this changes no treatment indicator in the sample (D = 1[fyear >= g_form_m1] equals TreatY x POST row by row) and gives CSA a base period (relative year -2). No duplicated gvkey-years; each gvkey is in one cartel. Pipeline-sample TWFE (raw units) = 0.152224 vs authors 0.152224 (-0.00%). Unit id gid = 'g' + gvkey (one-to-one with gvkey): with the raw character gvkey (leading zeros, e.g. '001001'), fixest::sparse_model_matrix inside did2s names the FE '1001', 10,684 of 13,919 gvkey columns come out all-zero, the sparse solve fails and did2s falls back to a dense SVD that did not finish in 18 min; the prefix changes no estimate (TWFE/CSA unaffected; did2s point estimate unaffected, its SE was being computed on a corrupted first-stage matrix).
